Observed_Risk_or_Need: Students need guidance on effective and responsible GenAI use.
Recommendation: Provide AI literacy training focused on active learning, academic integrity, and output evaluation.
Expected_Benefit: Better learning outcomes and lower misuse risk.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Very high GenAI usage is associated with higher dependency, anxiety, and burnout risk.
Recommendation: Encourage usage limits, self-monitoring, and balanced study routines.
Expected_Benefit: Reduced overreliance and better well-being outcomes.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Direct answer generation is associated with weaker academic outcomes and lower skill retention.
Recommendation: Teach students to ask for explanations, feedback, hints, and debugging support rather than direct final answers.
Expected_Benefit: Higher skill retention and more active learning.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Beginner prompt users show lower skill retention than advanced prompt users.
Recommendation: Offer prompt engineering workshops and examples of effective learning-oriented prompts.
Expected_Benefit: Better use of GenAI as a learning assistant.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: STEM students show strong academic outcomes but also higher burnout risk.
Recommendation: Provide targeted workload, dependency, and burnout monitoring for high-intensity technical learners.
Expected_Benefit: Stronger academic outcomes without ignoring well-being risks.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Graduate students show strong academic outcomes but high burnout risk.
Recommendation: Offer academic pressure management and responsible GenAI support for advanced students.
Expected_Benefit: Better support for high-pressure student groups.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Paid users show heavier GenAI usage and higher risk indicators.
Recommendation: Monitor whether paid access is leading to overreliance rather than better learning.
Expected_Benefit: More responsible use among high-access users.

Observed_Risk_or_Need: Strict-ban policy environments show higher anxiety and burnout indicators.
Recommendation: Consider replacing blanket bans with structured citation-based or guided-use policies.
Expected_Benefit: Lower anxiety and clearer expectations around AI use.
